title: CADDL housing and land-rights march to the National Assembly
location: Bourse du Travail to National Assembly
organizer: Coalition pour l’accès au logement et au développement durable (CADDL), with several participating associations reported
participants_original: Reports range from “hundreds of women” (NetAfrique) to “many people” (La Tribune); retain these approximate descriptions without invented numeric bounds. Three local reports describe the same march.
threshold_50_evidence: NetAfrique’s “hundreds” estimate is above 50, but remains an approximate, single-source attendance estimate; reviewer should assess it alongside the two corroborating reports.

start_date.summary: All three local reports date the CADDL action to 20 October 2020.

end_date.summary: Single-day march described; exact end time not reported.

location.summary: Route from Bourse du Travail to the National Assembly in Ouagadougou.

scope.summary: One local march; do not count each outlet report as a separate gathering.

organizer.summary: CADDL is identified as organizer; OUAGANEWS names participating groups.

demands.summary: Housing, serviced plots and changes addressing land appropriation/evictions and land policy.

participants_original.summary: Approximate terms only: hundreds of women / many people.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: One report’s hundreds estimate exceeds 50; no exact numeric count.

state_response.summary: Representatives delivered a claims platform/letter to the National Assembly secretariat, which was to be transmitted; no policy concession or coercive response documented.

notes: Civic housing/land-policy action, not an election campaign. State-facing demands and route are documented. Threshold is supported by one approximate estimate; reviewer to adjudicate.
open_questions: Confirm numeric sufficiency from contemporaneous source context and whether transmission of the platform should be coded as accommodation.

title: Bobo-Dioulasso truckers’ freight-management work stoppage and road blockage
scope: regional/national call with locally reported disruption in Bobo-Dioulasso
organizer: Union des chauffeurs routiers du Burkina (UCRB) announced the action; FUTRB appears in a report of suspension.
participants_original: Sources describe a 96-hour announced trucker stoppage over political involvement in freight management; one report says trucks blocked/occupied road space in Bobo.
threshold_50_evidence: No participant count. Do not convert truck count or work stoppage into a person count; whether an actual public gathering of at least 50 occurred is unresolved.

start_date.summary: Announcement stated 14 October start; one local report observed stoppage 14–18 October; exact start/time/continuity conflict unresolved.

end_date.summary: L’Express reports blockage across 14–18 October; Sidwaya reports suspension after roughly half a day.

location.summary: L’Express reports parked trucks on the Bobo-Dioulasso road toward Ouagadougou.

scope.summary: Nationwide 96-hour call, but actual extent disputed; Sidwaya says rapid suspension while L’Express reports disruption for several days in Bobo.

organizer.summary: UCRB is associated with the call; suspension is attributed to FUTRB. Relationship between bodies not resolved.

demands.summary: Opposition to political interference in freight allocation and regulation.

participants_original.summary: No people count supplied; only trucks described.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No per-site people count or proof of a simultaneous crowd of 50.

state_response.summary: Minister reportedly engaged on freight management; Sidwaya says action was suspended after negotiations, while another report records later Bobo road blockage. Specific concession and episode end require resolution.

notes: Labor dispute potentially involved a public roadway obstruction, but reports conflict on whether action ended after half a day or continued locally; strike participation alone does not establish qualifying assembly.
open_questions: Determine actual public gathering/onsite presence and per-site 50 threshold; reconcile suspension versus Oct14–18 Bobo disruption; clarify action start, organizer relation and any concrete state accommodation.

title: CDAIP coalition meeting on justice for uprising victims and election boycott
organizer: Coalition of civic and labor organizations led by CDAIP
threshold_50_evidence: No threshold evidence in the opened report.

end_date.summary: Single meeting reported; exact hours/end not stated.

scope.summary: One civic/labor coalition meeting, not a set of party campaign rallies.

demands.summary: Justice and care/compensation for victims of 2014 uprising; election boycott framed as response to ongoing state repression/exploitation.

state_response.summary: No response to this meeting reported.

notes: Election-related state-policy protest meeting, distinct from campaign support; no count is reported.
open_questions: Find attendance evidence; establish whether attendance reached 50. Clarify whether meeting was an assembly open to broader public or a coalition-only meeting.
